item.title: Rust on Microcontrollers in 2026: embedded-hal vs esp-hal vs rp-hal Compared
item.description: Embedded Rust stopped being an experiment the moment its interfaces stabilised. In 2026 the practical question is no longer “can I write firmware in Rust?” but “which HAL do I write my driver against, and what breaks when the silicon vendor changes it?” The three repositories that answer that question — embedded-hal, esp-hal and rp-hal — sit at different layers of the same stack, which is why comparing them as rivals misses the point and comparing them as collaborators is what actually ships products.
